title: Pure Tri-Brigade
summary: Pure Tri-Brigade link swarm and graveyard manipulation deck, utilizing Beast, Beast-Warrior, and Winged Beast monsters that banish materials from the GY to cheat out high-Link bosses without traditional Link Materials. The strategy loops GY floating effects to set up lethal disruptions and banishes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tri-Brigade Fraktall discards itself from hand to send any Level 3 or lower Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast from Deck to GY, kicking off the graveyard chain.
Tri-Brigade Kitt sends another Tri-Brigade card from Deck to GY when sent to the GY, acting as the ideal dump from Fraktall.
Tri-Brigade Nervall adds a Tri-Brigade monster from Deck to hand when sent to the GY, completing the standard search relay.
Tri-Brigade Kerass discards any Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast to Special Summon itself from the hand, offering vital extension.
Tri-Brigade Hammer searches a Tri-Brigade Spell or Trap or banishes materials from GY to cheat out a Tri-Brigade Link Monster.
Tri-Brigade Springans Kitt Special Summons itself next to a Tri-Brigade and revives a banished or GY Tri-Brigade when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Fraktall Combo
steps: Discard Tri-Brigade Fraktall to send Tri-Brigade Kitt from your Deck to the GY.
Tri-Brigade Kitt triggers in GY to send Tri-Brigade Nervall from Deck to GY.
Tri-Brigade Nervall triggers in GY to add Tri-Brigade Kerass from Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Tri-Brigade Kerass (or discard a Beast to Special Summon it) and activate its effect, banishing 2 monsters from GY to cheat out Tri-Brigade Bearbrumm the Rampant Rampager.
Link Summon Tri-Brigade Rugal the Silver Sheller (or Ferrijit) using Kerass and Bearbrumm, triggering Bearbrumm in GY to add Tri-Brigade Revolt to hand.
Set Tri-Brigade Revolt and pass, ready to summon Shuraig during the opponent's turn to banish a card and trigger full GY recovery.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen banishes 1 card on the field without targeting whenever another Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast is Special Summoned to your field, and searches a monster with Level equal to or lower than your banished cards when sent to GY.
Tri-Brigade Rugal the Silver Sheller Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast from hand or GY during the opponent's Main Phase, lowering enemy monsters' ATK.
Tri-Brigade Arms Bucephalus II prevents your monster summons from being responded to and banishes all cards your opponent controls when an attack is declared.
Tri-Brigade Arms Mouser mills two Tri-Brigade cards on Link Summon and can flip an enemy monster face-down when sent to the GY.
Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon is accessed via Extra Deck manipulation (such as sending Bucephalus II to GY to dump Albion or send Albaz Fusions) to banish non-targeting Quick Effect removal.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Tri-Brigade Revolt Special Summons banished and GY Beasts, Beast-Warriors, and Winged Beasts to immediately Link Summon a Tri-Brigade Link Monster (typically Shuraig) on the opponent's turn, triggering all sent materials.
Tri-Brigade Roar sends a Tri-Brigade Link from Extra Deck to GY to reduce an opponent monster's ATK to 0, negate its effects, or return it to the hand.
Tri-Brigade Airborne Assault Special Summons a monster with a different Type from your Deck with ATK less than or equal to a monster on field.
Tri-Brigade Stand-Off, Showdown, and Rendezvous provide ATK modulation, recovery of banished cards, and destruction shielding from the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: External Branded and Springans engine variants (such as Branded Fusion or Springans Kitt packages) are excluded in favor of a pure Tri-Brigade lineup that stays consistently within the archetype's Beast-type summon locks.
